Method of Attack: Flooding PyPI with spam packages named after popular movies mimicking torrent/warez sites
Packages contain spam keywords and links to quasi-video streaming sites
Use of pseudonymous maintainer accounts to evade takedown
Inclusion of code and author info lifted from legitimate PyPI packages to mask malicious intent
Discoverer: Adam Boesch, senior software engineer at Sonatype
Attack Vector: Publishing spam packages to PyPI repository by multiple pseudonymous accounts
Indicators of Compromise: URLs linking to questionable movie streaming sites such as https://besflix[.]com/movie/XXXXX/profile.html
